scope: creative monetization outside charcoal across the public internet, including small tested website, coding, writing, translation, research and data work

external_observation_notes: Re-run every official public source and reject stale, awarded, historical, location-bound, excessively crowded or unverifiable listings.
Prioritize static websites, narrow frontend fixes, Python automations, bounded API integrations, research, translation and structured-data deliverables under 16 hours.
Preserve zero submissions and zero revenue unless an external platform receipt or payment proof exists.

software_scope_policy: accept only remotely deliverable testable software missions no greater than 16 hours; reject complete applications, clones, unlimited support, access bypass, off-platform payment and high-risk production changes
payment_policy: accept any lawful payer-supported method and document it truthfully
human_gate_policy: prepare source, fixtures, tests, manifest and proposal autonomously, then request only the smallest concrete account, terms, KYC, signature, payout, deployment or validation action
